readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard was still in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard went out into the street.
The piano started up in the salon as Girard lit his cigar.
Girard heard faint quick bells from the master's window while the piano was playing.
Girard came back into the house.
The hall clock had just struck eleven when Girard came back into the house.
Girard saw the hall clock's face, which showed two minutes past eleven, when he came back into the house.

whereabouts: Girard came to the dinner because Monnier asked him.
At dinner, Girard quarrelled with Monnier about the price for the movement rights; Monnier laughed at him across the table.
At nine o'clock, Girard was present when Monnier had everyone show their watches; Girard kept his in his pocket.
After dinner, Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard was still in the dining room when the temple struck ten.
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 by his watch.
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house after going out.
Girard was in the street when the piano started in the salon at 10:29 by his watch.
Girard was in the street when he heard the bells from the master's window at 10:34 by his watch.
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
After coming back in, Girard went up to Félix in the library.
